name: Financial Assistance for Girl Child Attend Her Age of 18
benefit:
- Fixed deposit of ₹1,00,000/- for one female child.
> **Note:** The fixed deposit will remain in the bank until the girl child turns 18 years old.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker in Maharashtra. 1. The worker or their spouse must have undergone contraceptive surgery after the birth of one female child.
